🪶 Hieronymus v0.7.0α
Remembers things for you.
Alpha software: local-first, usable at your own risk.

📖 Service
  hiero                  Start or connect to the local service
  hiero status           Show daemon and provider status
  hiero status --json    Emit daemon and provider status for scripts
  hiero stop             Request graceful daemon shutdown
  hiero restart          Restart the local daemon

📖 Management
  hiero config           Open the configuration web console
  hiero config --json    Emit config, provider, dreaming, ingest, and release state
  hiero admin            Open the local management web console
  hiero admin --json     Emit management counts and available views
  hiero doctor           Check configuration and service health
  hiero doctor --json    Emit configuration and service diagnostics

📖 Agent and automation
  hiero session-start <series> --task-type <type> --json
  hiero remember-short <session-id> --role user --kind correction
      --text <text> --json
  hiero recall <session-id> --series <series> --query <query>
      --source-language <src> --target-language <dst>
      --task-type <type> --json
  hiero feedback <crystal-id> --event confirmed_by_user --role user --json
  hiero skills install --target agents --target claude

📖 Maintenance
  hiero install codex --dry-run
  hiero update           Update managed installs in place
  hiero dream --json     Run local dreaming and emit machine-readable status

📖 Examples
  hiero status --json
  hiero session-start oso --task-type translation --json
  hiero recall 1 --series oso --query "style"
      --source-language ja --target-language en
      --task-type translation --json
